title: Project X
description: Project aimed at increasing the online presence of AXARCA (Cariri Woodcut and Handicraft Association) through the creation of an e-commerce platform.
features: Complete development of the project's frontend using Next.js and TypeScript to ensure a fluid and high-performance user experience.
Implementation of an e-commerce platform focused on expanding the digital visibility of the Cariri Woodcut and Handicraft Association.
Creation of reusable components and strict typing to maintain scalability and ease of code maintenance.

title: Efficiency Program
description: Management systems developed in partnership with the City Hall of Juazeiro do Norte to streamline public administration and health services.
features: Developed and maintained critical management systems for the Juazeiro do Norte City Hall, focusing on judicial compliance and public health logistics.
Built a robust medication scheduling system to manage inventory and patient appointments, significantly improving access to essential medicine for citizens.
Implemented a secure tracking system for court orders (mandados judiciais) to ensure legal deadlines were met and administrative transparency was maintained.

title: Web Finance Automation
description: Multi-tenant financial automation API for accounting offices, featuring automatic transaction extraction from PDF cash reports using Go and Clean Architecture.
features: Designed a robust multi-tenant system where data for users, clients, bank accounts, and transactions are strictly isolated by tenant ID, ensuring security for accounting firm clients.
Implemented a high-performance PDF parser in Go to automate the extraction of financial transactions from cash reports, reducing manual entry time and marking extracted data for auditability.

Engineered the backend using Clean Architecture and Hexagonal principles to ensure high maintainability, testability, and a clear separation between business logic and external frameworks like Echo and GORM.
